pattern: runtime-modules.ts discovers virtual package names by scanning the first directory and extension of the resolved package root
source: const rootEntry = Bun.resolveSync(pkgName, from); const ext = path.extname(rootEntry); for (const file of new Bun.Glob("**/*" + ext).scanSync({cwd: scanDir})) { entries.set(pkgName + "/" + file.slice(0, -ext.length), file) }
